name: coralop
title: CoralOP: CoralFlower's chord instrument
summary: Shift + insert turns the synth keyboard into CoralFlower (FicusFicusov/CoralFlower, after the Telepathic Instruments Orchid): black keys are chord buttons (M6 M7 M9 | s2 s4 | m6 m7 m9 | M m, latching in Lock), white keys roots in the key's scale degrees; Side layouts as CoralFlower's. Each chord goes out on USB MIDI as two parts, CHORD and BASS, on their own channels (1 and 2), and on the OP-1's synth when LOCAL is on. T1 PLAY (Quantize, Key, 27 scales, layout), T2 CHORD (the last pressed button's type, added degrees, inversion, bass degree), T3 BASS / MIDI, T4 HOLD. MIDI channel 16 remote-controls it (keys, every setting; state and chord names sent back) for the Pd / plugdata and Max panels in remote/.
authors: CoralFlower: FicusFicusov (after ChoralRoot FM-1 by Quixotic7 and Felucca by Leo Kuroshita)
controls: shift + insert: CoralOP on (panel opens) / panel again / off (while the panel shows)
insert while the panel shows: pin it (no timeout) / unpin
synth playmode while on: black keys = chord buttons, white keys = roots (Top layouts); keys go to CoralOP only
T1 PLAY: blue QUANTIZE, green KEY, white SCALE, orange LAYOUT
T2 CHORD: the last pressed chord button: blue TYPE, green ADD, white INVERSION, orange BASS DEGREE
T3 BASS (T3 again: MIDI): blue BASS on/off, green OCTAVE, white OCTAVER, orange RETRIG; MIDI: blue CHORD CH, green BASS CH, white LOCAL, orange VELOCITY
TE's octave arrows set CoralFlower's octave
MIDI channel 16 in: notes 53..76 = the 24 keys, 78 = HOLD, CC 20..31 / 102 / 104..108 settings, 109 panic, 110 dump; out: the same CCs, 112..118 state and chord name
status_note: 0.2: remote control on MIDI channel 16; Seq thread owns the model
